Use case: precise-object-edit
The reference is the EXACT ORIGINAL Silent Storm Fire03 full128x128 particle animation frame, enlarged8x by nearest neighbor from native RGB only. This helper adds no art. Native TransparentAdd alpha is uniformly0 with useful RGB; the opaque support only exposes original native artwork. Root restores original alpha0.
Edit this ORIGINAL into a faithful smooth HD painted flame texture. Preserve EVERY original normalized UV coordinate, occupied footprint, contour, original component/tip/loop/fleck count, internal black channels/holes, relative size, material and scale. Return exactly one full square frame on black, not a scene, photo,3D render, atlas or sprite sheet. Do not crop/zoom/recenter/shift/rotate/repack/add margins. Existing source flames that reach the upper canvas edge must reach that same edge. Original dark borders stay the same width.
Source orange flame is painted, muted and relatively smooth: only soften its coarse pixels into the very same original forms with restrained smooth source shading. Do not reinterpret it as photoreal turbulent fire or new detailed fractal material. Do not invent ANY new curl, tendril, loop, filament, flame tongue, spike, extra puff, detached ember, bright crack, sparkle, ray, star, ring, object or glow. Existing source curls remain their exact same shapes, count and widths. Every black negative-space hole keeps its exact outline and position, without tiny new cuts or bright threads filling it. Keep source very dark/faint patches dark and softly fading; no whitened center, white-hot glints, extra yellow highlights, sharpened cutout perimeter, or additional contrast. Do not turn a faint source patch into a luminous star. Numeric brightness correction happens later. Do not join source-separated components or divide a connected source form. Preserve soft source outer transitions and original orange/brown hues, with no new decorative texture or invented marks. No text, symbols, logos or border.
Source-specific constraints: Tall original orange painted flame column, touching the top border with the same narrow upper branching cap, broad mid-height bright right-hand mass, original large darker upper-left and lower-center openings, lower-left fading patches and exact curled lower-right taper. Keep every original hole, separated orange patch, tongue and tip in its source location. Preserve the strongly dark empty left/right margins.
